methodology.mission: Open planetary analog intelligence platform matching Earth terrain cells to lunar (Artemis) and Martian landing and base baselines using multi-spectral orbital datasets.
methodology.mission_ar: منصة ذكاء اصطناعي مفتوحة لنظائر التضاريس الكوكبية، تطابق الخلايا الأرضية مع معايير استكشاف القمر (برنامج أرتميس) والمريخ باستخدام بيانات الأقمار الاصطناعية المدارية متعددة الأطياف.

kpis.recall_rate: 94.2% (autonomously retrieved 46 of 49 peer-reviewed historic Apollo, NASA, and ESA rover analog sites)
kpis.catalog_size: 53 Earth sites (47 candidates/analogs + 6 negative controls), 31 Mars targets, 30 Moon targets

stage_1.name: Physical Hard Gate via MODIS NDVI
stage_1.name_ar: بوابة الترشيح الفيزيائي الحتمي عبر مؤشر الغطاء النباتي MODIS NDVI
stage_1.rule: Barren/abiotic gate. Sites with NDVI > 0.20 are immediately disqualified due to vegetative or biological activity.
stage_1.purpose: Eliminates non-space biomes (Amazon, Nile Delta, Iowa Corn Belt, Manhattan) without data leakage. Also transparently highlights biological canopy encroachment on volcanic lava tube analogs (e.g. Medicine Lake Volcano NDVI 0.285, Thurston Lava Tube NDVI 0.310).

stage_2.name: TASI Multi-Criteria Parametric Similarity Ranking
stage_2.name_ar: نموذج تصنيف التشابه متعدد المعايير TASI
stage_2.mars_formula: Mars Similarity weights 4 physical parameters equally (25% each): Topographic Slope Percentile, Surface Roughness Percentile (Geomorpho90m), Albedo Norm (MODIS MCD43A3 vs TES/MCD), and Diurnal Thermal Swing Norm (MODIS LST vs MCD).
stage_2.moon_formula: Moon Similarity weights 3 physical parameters equally (33.3% each): Topographic Slope Percentile, Surface Roughness Percentile, and Albedo Norm (1064nm LOLA). Thermal swing is physically excluded due to lunar vacuum physics (no atmosphere).
stage_2.distance_metric: Mahalanobis covariance-weighted distance combined with cosine kernels, preventing collinear variables (like slope & roughness) from overpowering spectral signatures.

data_sources.name: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS)
data_sources.instruments: LRO LOLA (elevation & roughness LDEM_16, LDRM_16), LRO Diviner (surface temperature GCP, Williams et al. 2017), MRO CRISM/HiRISE, MGS MOLA (MEGDR 463m), Mars 2020 SuperCam

data_sources.name: ESA Copernicus Programme
data_sources.instruments: Sentinel-2 Multi-Spectral Surface Reflectance (Level 2A MSI, 10m-20m resolution, clay and ferrous band absorption ratios)

data_sources.name: NASA Terra MODIS
data_sources.instruments: MOD11A2 v061 (8-day 1km Land Surface Temperature LST - strictly surface skin temperature, not 2-meter air temperature); MOD13A2 v061 (16-day 1km NDVI vegetation index); MCD43A3 v061 (Daily 500m Black Sky / White Sky Albedo)

data_sources.name: USGS Astrogeology & NASA JPL
data_sources.instruments: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, IAU Nomenclature, NASADEM HGT v001 (30m ICESat-calibrated SRTM), Geomorpho90m (Amatulli et al. 2020 Nature Scientific Data), ASTER GEDv4

data_sources.name: Mars Climate Database (MCD v5.3 / v6.1)
data_sources.instruments: LMD/CNES/ESA climatological surface thermal modeling (diurnal cycle, Ls=3.6 scenario)

earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint: Earth cannot reproduce reduced gravity. Low gravity dramatically alters rover wheel sinkage, tire traction grouser slip, and regolith excavation mechanics. Counterweights or offloading gantry rigs are required.
earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint_ar: لا يمكن للأرض محاكاة الجاذبية المنخفضة؛ فالجاذبية القمرية سدس الأرض وجاذبية المريخ ثلثها، مما يغير آليات غوص العجلات واحتكاك الحطام الصخري ويتطلب موازين ميكانيكية أثناء التجارب.

earth_simulation_limits.earth_val: Shielded by 1013 mbar atmosphere and global geomagnetic field (background ~0.007 mSv/day)
earth_simulation_limits.moon_val: Direct unshielded exposure (~1.3 mSv/day, cumulative astronaut career limit in ~200 days)
earth_simulation_limits.mars_val: Thin atmosphere (6.1 mbar CO2) without dipolar magnetic field (~0.6-0.7 mSv/day)
earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint: Terrestrial test sites cannot simulate space radiation environments. Radiation hardening must be tested in particle accelerator chambers.
earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint_ar: يحجب الغلاف الجوي والمجال المغناطيسي للأرض الإشعاع الكوني، بينما يتعرض القمر والمريخ لجرعات إشعاعية قاتلة تتطلب اختبارات في مسرعات الجسيمات ومطيافات متخصصة.

earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint: Causes rapid thermal sublimation of volatile ice, dry out of lubricants, cold-welding of unoxidized metal contacts, and electrostatic dust levitation without air damping.
earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint_ar: يؤدي الفراغ الفائق في الفضاء إلى تسامي الجليد وجفاف زيوت التشحيم واللحام البارد للمعادن، والتصاق كهروستاتيكي حاد لغبار الثرى.

earth_simulation_limits.mars_val: Planetary protection Category IVc (extreme sterilization needed to avoid false life detections)
earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint: Earth field trials always have microbial presence, requiring careful cleaning when validating life-detection instruments.
earth_simulation_limits.scientific_constraint_ar: تحتوي كافة البيئات الأرضية على كائنات حية دقيقة، مما يستلزم عزلًا بروتوكوليًا صارمًا لضمان عدم تلوث أدوات الكشف عن الحياة.

valid_analog_tests: Rover mobility, chassis suspension, wheel tread abrasion & steep slope climb tests
Regolith geotechnical shear strength, drilling, and sample coring mechanics
Dust settlement and electrostatic adhesion on photovoltaic solar arrays and optical lenses
Autonomous SLAM mapping, LiDAR navigation, and GPS-denied robotics inside basaltic lava tubes
Human factors, extravehicular activity (EVA) suit ergonomic mobility, and analog habitat operations
In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU) regolith bagging, sintered brick building, and volatile baking tests
